He's such a charmer!|audio = NullGuardianQuote.ogg|[[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] in the first [[Banlands]] cutscene}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Guardian''' was an entity which roamed the [[Old World|Nil Zone]]. He was the warden of the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]], at some point appointed to this role by the [[Rift Walker]]. He patrolled the area in search of anyone banished here by him, which he would execute. ==Personality== Due to his limited appearance, there was very little information on his personality. The '''Null Guardian''' appeared to be very dedicated, as he has managed to uphold his duty of being the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]]'s guardian for what can be assumed to be ages. The '''Null Guardian''' has memory issues caused by his cloning ability, which made him reliant on his connection to chaotic energy to remember who he was. ==Abilities & Characteristics== {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" ! colspan="2" |Abilities |- | colspan="2" |'''Cloning''': The '''Null Guardian''' was capable of cloning himself using the fragments of his memories. This, however, came at a cost of him losing his memories.{{InlineQuote|The [[Null Guardian Clone]] is a manifestation of chaotic energy, born from fragments of the '''Guardian''''s own memories. Each clone is a snapshot of who he was moments before made into physical form. Each time the '''Guardian''' uses his abilities, his memory is sacrificed, slowly forgetting his own history and becoming more reliant on the [[Old World|Nil Zone]] to remember who he once was.|[[Null Guardian Clone]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} |- ! colspan="2" |Other |- | colspan="2" |'''Connection to The Nil Zone''': The '''Null Guardian''' was connected to the [[Old World|Nil Zone]]'s chaotic energy, which let him experience its history.{{InlineQuote|The '''Guardian''' is connected to the chaotic energy of the [[Old World|Nil Zone]], allowing him to perceive and experience the realm's history within it.|[[Null Guardian]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} This was used by him to cope with the memory loss caused by his cloning, making him reliant on the [[Old World|Nil Zone]] to remember who he was.{{InlineQuote|Each time the '''Guardian''' uses his abilities, his memory is sacrificed, slowly forgetting his own history and becoming more reliant on the [[Old World|Nil Zone]] to remember who he once was.|[[Null Guardian Clone]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} |- |'''The Rift Walker's Failsafe''': The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] had placed a failsafe onto the '''Null Guardian''', which, in the event of his death, would teleport his killer to the [[Rift Walker]] himself to deal with them. This failsafe was shown at the end of [[Banlands]], teleporting the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] and the T.D.S. agents to the [[Rift Walker]]'s location. ||[[File:FailSafeActivates.gif|200px|center|thumb]] |} ==Story== ===Unknown=== The '''Null Guardian''' is recruited at one point by the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] to patrol the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]]. ===Null & Void=== During the [[Null & Void Event]], the '''Null Guardian''' caught [[Titus]] and started carrying him to the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]]. There, he runs into the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] and multiple [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents, with the former slapping [[Titus]] away. With his initial target gone, he instead set his sight on the [[T.D.S. Organization]] and the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]], leading to a temporary alliance between the two. The '''Null Guardian''' is eventually defeated, which leads to a failsafe activating in his body that redirected the [[T.D.S. Organization]] and [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] to the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Night 2 Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center|Null Guardian in the opening and ending cutscene of [[Banlands]] }} ==Trivia== *The [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description for the [[Null Guardian]] enemy states that the '''Null Guardian''' was in the [[Old World|Nil Zone]] ever since before the [[Old World]].{{InlineQuote|The '''Null Guardian''' has existed within the [[Old World|Nil Zone]] since before the [[Old World]], (...)|[[Null Guardian]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} However, through [[The Final Act Event]], it is revealed that the [[Old World|Nil Zone]] is what remains of the [[Old World]], making what the [[Logbooks|Logbook]] claims extremely implausible.{{InlineQuote|Now that [[Lord Exo]] was defeated, [[Two X]] was left with an uninhabitable wasteland that became the [[Old World|Nil Zone]]!|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 20 ([[The Narratorium]])}}
{{InlineQuote|Wait, we were in the [[Old World]]?!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 20 ([[The Narratorium]])}} ==Notes== {{StoryNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Null Guardian}}
